summary: Established a robust architectural governance framework by integrating AST-based parsing, Bayesian anomaly detection, and Pydantic-based schema enforcement. By shifting focus from binary task completion to stochastic stability metrics and strict input contracts, system reliability and structural integrity have been significantly enhanced.
key_learnings: AST-based parsing and Pydantic schema validation ensure system determinism and reduce malformed operations.
Bayesian inference and KL divergence provide a robust foundation for identifying systemic anomalies.
Importance sampling and adaptive optimizers improve test efficiency and prevent early divergence.
Architectural metrics are most effective when tracking variance in behavior checks rather than simple pass/fail states.
Strict input contracts are essential for maintaining structural integrity during core system modifications.
